A little more clarity

Before
you visit.

What should I bring to my consultation?

Bring previous prescriptions or relevant reports and a list of products and medicines you currently use. Note your main questions so you can discuss them during your visit.

Can I discuss both skin and hair concerns?

You can mention both in your enquiry. The clinic can confirm the appointment length and whether a separate visit is needed.

How do I know which treatment to choose?

You do not need to choose a procedure in advance. Start with your concern and ask the clinician about suitable options after assessment.

Where can I check fees and appointment times?

Fees, the clinic address, opening hours, and confirmed booking contact details will be added to this page after clinic verification. This preview does not offer confirmed appointment slots.
